issues.description: The problem statement and UML explicitly require SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to return a double (it even stresses using double precision for financial calculations). However, the solution implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (double) and the implemented return type (int) is structural: students following the spec will implement/expect a double-returning method, and tests or grading that check the signature will fail or cause confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature and implementation consistent with the problem statement: change calculateTotalPrice to return double (public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and compute/return a double value (e.g., accumulate into a double sum or cast the integer sum to double). Ensure any usages/tests expect the double return type as well.
